# Nova Browser

> Sovereign, AI-Native Desktop Web Browser with Local WebGPU Inference, Rust Ad-Blocker, Zero-Knowledge Sync, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration.

Nova Browser is an open-source, privacy-first desktop web browser built for modern power users, developers, and researchers. Unlike legacy browsers that upload personal browsing history or prompt data to cloud servers, Nova executes multi-model LLMs directly on local device silicon using WebGPU.

## Key Technical Specifications & Highlights

- **Local WebGPU AI Inference**: Direct on-device LLM execution with zero cloud latency and 100% privacy. Runs Llama 3.2, Phi-3.5 Vision, and Qwen 2.5 directly on GPU.
- **Autonomous AI Agent & Virtual Cursor**: Built-in visual AI agent capable of navigating websites, analyzing complex documents, summarizing papers, and executing tasks via Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- **Zero-Latency Rust Ad-Blocker**: Memory-mapped network filtering engine stopping ads, trackers, and telemetry with zero CPU overhead.
- **Zero-Knowledge Cloud Sync**: End-to-end encrypted device pairing using Web Crypto API (AES-GCM-256) and ephemeral pairing codes.
- **Modern Vertical & Split Tabs**: Arc-inspired workspace organization with pinned apps, tab folders, split screen views, and auto-hibernation.
- **Platform Support**: Native binaries for macOS (Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4 & Intel x64) and Windows 10/11 (64-bit).

## Installation Methods

### macOS via Homebrew (Recommended)
```bash
brew tap unitybtw/tap
brew install --cask nova-browser
```

### Direct Download & Releases
- macOS Apple Silicon (ARM64 DMG): https://github.com/unitybtw/nova-browser/releases/latest/download/Nova-Browser-arm64.dmg
- macOS Intel (x64 DMG): https://github.com/unitybtw/nova-browser/releases/latest/download/Nova-Browser-x64.dmg
- Windows Setup (x64 EXE): https://github.com/unitybtw/nova-browser/releases/latest/download/Nova-Browser-Setup.exe

### Source Code Repository
- GitHub: https://github.com/unitybtw/nova-browser
- License: MIT Open Source

## Comparison Overview

| Feature | Nova Browser | Arc Browser | Brave Browser | Google Chrome |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Local AI (WebGPU)** | Yes (100% On-Device) | No (Cloud Server) | No (Cloud Server) | No |
| **Telemetry & Tracking** | Zero (100% Sovereign) | Partial Telemetry | Partial Telemetry | Heavy Tracking |
| **License** | MIT Open Source | Proprietary Closed | MPL 2.0 Open | Proprietary |
| **MCP AI Server Integration** | Built-in (Port 3020) | No | No | No |
| **Ad-Blocker Engine** | Rust-native Zero-Latency | No Built-in Engine | Rust / C++ Engine | Manifest V3 Limited |
